Portable core tests alone do not establish SIMD execution or a performance advantage.
objective_map.executed_claim_limit: Neither a passing model nor a compiled target establishes all the objective text, changed conditions, actual target behavior or independent learner understanding.

consequential_open_gaps: Linux model cleanup and lifetime transitions are not guest module load/unload, RCU, lockdep or KASAN evidence.
Cross-assembled RV64/AArch64 contexts are not executed hostile-register, reset, trap-return or translation ports.
Hosted firmware arrays and journal cuts do not establish real flash granularity, secure image verification, power loss or dual-core board behavior.
The compiled and emulated compiler is the explicitly unsigned expression notation; declarations, control flow, calls and pointers lack completed reference implementations.
CBMC harnesses have no solver result; finite state words and fuzz executions cannot be renamed proofs.
io_uring setup does not execute submission/cancellation; splice, crash persistence and changed buffer ownership remain open.
Local memory-security witnesses establish only their named original-target violations; no general exploitation or mitigation efficacy is inferred.
Vector instruction observations and numeric differential cases do not supply equivalent-contract timing, traffic or physical measurements.
